filingRisks.title: Cybersecurity and data privacy
filingRisks.detail: The filing reports that cybersecurity risks could result in economic losses to its businesses and reputational damage.
evidence: Cybersecurity risks could result in economic losses to our businesses and reputational damage.

Cyber-attacks could further adversely affect our ability to operate our facilities, information technology and business systems or could compromise confidential company, customer and employee information.

filingRisks.title: Regulation and legal exposure
filingRisks.detail: The filing reports that failure to comply with these increased laws and regulations could result in reputation damage and significant economic penalties.
evidence: Failure to comply with these increased laws and regulations could result in reputation damage and significant economic penalties.
Furthermore, our regulated energy subsidiaries are exposed to losses arising from wildfires and related litigation and judicial outcomes.

filingRisks.title: Competition and innovation
filingRisks.detail: The filing reports that additionally, if the company is unable to acquire, develop, implement, adopt or protect rights around new technology, the company may suffer a competitive disadvantage, which could also have an adverse effect on its results of operations, financial condition and/or liquidity.
evidence: Additionally, if we are unable to acquire, develop, implement, adopt or protect rights around new technology, we may suffer a competitive disadvantage, which could also have an adverse effect on our results of operations, financial condition and/or liquidity.

Our large statutory surplus is a competitive advantage, and a long-term material decline could have an adverse effect on our claims-paying ability ratings and our ability to write new insurance business, thus potentially reducing our future underwriting profits.

filingRisks.title: International and geopolitical exposure
filingRisks.detail: The filing reports that geopolitical events could cause losses to its business and losses in the values of securities the company own.
evidence: Geopolitical events could cause losses to our business and losses in the values of securities we own.
In addition, international trade policies in the U.S. and elsewhere, including tariffs and other barriers, could negatively impact our operating results.

filingRisks.title: People and execution
filingRisks.detail: The filing reports that if for any reason the services of its key personnel were to become unavailable, there could be a material adverse effect on its operations.
evidence: If for any reason the services of our key personnel were to become unavailable, there could be a material adverse effect on our operations.
Further, labor disruptions or strikes at our subsidiaries, our customers or within our supply chains could reduce our sales, increase our costs and negatively impact our periodic operating results.

filingRisks.title: Financial and liquidity risk
filingRisks.detail: The filing reports that its inability to recruit, train and retain qualified and competent managers and personnel could negatively affect the operating results, financial condition and liquidity of its subsidiaries and Berkshire as a whole.
evidence: Our inability to recruit, train and retain qualified and competent managers and personnel could negatively affect the operating results, financial condition and liquidity of our subsidiaries and Berkshire as a whole.
Restricted access to debt capital markets by BNSF or BHE could adversely affect the results of operations, liquidity and/or capital resources of these businesses.

filingRisks.title: Macroeconomic conditions and demand
filingRisks.detail: The filing reports that unfavorable general economic conditions may significantly reduce its operating earnings and impair its ability to access capital markets at a reasonable cost.
evidence: Unfavorable general economic conditions may significantly reduce our operating earnings and impair our ability to access capital markets at a reasonable cost.
Significant deteriorations of economic conditions, including significant inflation over prolonged time periods could produce a material adverse effect on one or more of our significant operations.

filingRisks.title: Climate and physical events
filingRisks.detail: The filing reports that climate change and the regulation of greenhouse gas (“GHG”) emissions may impact its businesses.
evidence: Climate change and the regulation of greenhouse gas (“GHG”) emissions may impact our businesses.
Climate-related events, including hurricanes, floods, wildfires, and other extreme weather events may increase the physical risks and impacts to our operations.
